messages:
maya: quick heads-up — during a runbook replay I hit a 404 on the 'Restarting inference' step 3 link. blocking a postmortem writeup :grimacing:

maya: link shown in the step points to `/runbooks/restarting-inference#step-3` but the page is 404. snippet:
```
https://kb.redwood.internal/runbooks/restarting-inference#step-3
```

tom: ahhh. thanks for surfacing. do we know the canonical doc that should be there?

maya: not 100% — looks like the page moved during the runbook rename last sprint. quick fix is either redirect or update the anchor to the new section (`restarting-inference#commands`).

docs-bot: :robot_face: docs scan alert created — ticket DOCS-1189 referencing thread 6319456780.

eli: I can open a tiny PR to replace the anchor+link. will do the redirect if that’s faster. pinging @juan for final wording?

juan: share whatever is easiest — prefer redirect so historical runbooks keep working, but update to the new anchor too.

eli: ok doing both. prepping a redirect + tiny md change. will include this in the PR title: "runbook: fix restarting-inference link + redirect (DOCS-1189)"

eli: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2734 — includes 301 redirect and updated anchor. small test steps in the PR body. :sparkles:

maya: 🙏 thanks! can you add a one-line changelog note and tag @tom for review?

eli: added changelog entry and tagged @tom. requesting quick CR — priority low but unblocks postmortem.

tom: on it, will review in the next 30m. if it looks clean i'll merge and cherry-pick to staging.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: DOCS-1189 updated: redirect merged to staging once PR is approved.

maya: awesome — leaving a follow-up in the postmortem draft to note this fix. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
